_comment: Trigger sources for the Insights workflow. These feeds are used to spot news
worth commenting on — never to reproduce content. Headlines and links only.
Creamer Media titles (Engineering News, Mining Weekly) are largely paywalled;
treat them strictly as a signal that a topic is live.
Feed URLs are best-effort and unverified from the authoring environment,
which cannot reach these hosts. Run 'python3 tools/scan_news.py --verify'
somewhere with open internet (the GitHub Action does this) to confirm each
one and prune what does not resolve.

sources.name: Engineering News
sources.note: SA infrastructure, water, construction, tenders. Primary signal.

sources.name: Mining Weekly
sources.note: Mining infrastructure. Unicon built Thabazimbi for Anglo American.

sources.name: African Development Bank
sources.note: Funding announcements precede tenders. Highest-value early warning.

sources.name: World Bank
sources.note: Filter hard to Africa water and infrastructure.

sources.name: Farmer's Weekly
sources.note: Agri-processing, irrigation, dairy. Matches Bayonne Dairy and Mnqumashe abattoir.
